# RedRoom Fitness — Corporate Website

## Overview

Build a 5-page dark, bold corporate website for **RedRoom Fitness**, a premium HIIT workout brand that combines treadmill running and strength training. The site targets fitness enthusiasts and health-conscious adults aged 20–45, aiming to drive in-studio class bookings, promote a digital on-demand platform, and convert newcomers through free trial offers.

## Visual Direction

This site should feel **intense, premium, and immersive** — think dark gym lighting with dramatic red accents. Use a near-black background (`#111` or similar) with **bold red** (`#E63946` or a deep crimson) as the primary accent color. White and light gray text for contrast. Typography should be strong and modern — a condensed, uppercase sans-serif (like Oswald or Bebas Neue) for headlines, paired with a clean body font (Inter, Helvetica Neue). Generous whitespace between sections, full-bleed imagery, and large CTAs that demand attention.

## Key Priorities

- **The homepage carousel and free-trial CTA** are critical conversion elements — the carousel must feel smooth and polished, and the trial CTA should be visually dominant.
- **The Workout page's Floor/Treadmill toggle** is the core interactive moment for educating visitors — make the content switch feel seamless and intuitive.
- **Instructor filtering by location** must work correctly across all listed cities; the grid should feel dynamic when filters change.
- **The FAQ accordion** should follow single-open behavior (collapsing others when one opens).
- **Newsletter validation** should provide clear inline feedback on email input.
- The **weekly schedule table** on the workout page needs to be scannable and well-structured — this is how users decide which day to attend.

Ensure all pages share a consistent nav bar and footer. The site must be fully responsive and dark-mode by default.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# RedRoom Fitness — The Best HIIT Workout in the World

## Brand
RedRoom Fitness is the original high-intensity interval training experience, combining treadmill running and strength training in a signature red-lit studio environment. Founded for those who demand more from their workout, RedRoom delivers results through science-backed HIIT methodology across global studio locations and a digital on-demand platform. The tone is bold, dark, and unapologetically intense.

Brand colors: `#FF0000` (RedRoom Red — primary), `#141414` (Charcoal Black — background), `#FFFFFF` (White — text/accent)

## Hero Content
Title: "TRY THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD™"
Subtitle: "Buy an exclusive first-timer 3-pack and receive a FREE Fuel Shake or Grab + Go item after your third class."
CTA: "BUY NOW" | "BOOK CLASSES"

## Top Bar Promo
Text: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"
CTA: "Learn More" → links to Digital Platform page

## Community Promo
Heading: "Join the Hustle"
Body: "Welcome to RedRoom. More than a workout — it's a movement. Our global community of athletes, first-timers, and everyone in between push limits together in the Red Room. Show up. Work hard. Earn your place."
CTA: "Explore the Community"

## Two Ways to Red Room
Heading: "TWO WAYS TO RED ROOM"
Option 1: **In-Studio** — "Get a (Red) Room. Step inside our signature red-lit studios for the full immersive experience. Heart-pounding music, elite instructors, and the energy of the pack."
Option 2: **Digital** — "Go Digital. Stream world-class workouts from anywhere. Same intensity, your schedule."

## The Workout — Method Overview
Heading: "THE REDROOM WAY"
Body: "Every class is a 50-minute full-body experience. You'll alternate between the treadmill and the floor, combining high-intensity cardio intervals with focused strength training. Our method is designed to maximize calorie burn, build lean muscle, and keep your metabolism elevated for hours after class. Hustle and heart set us apart."

## Floor vs. Treadmill Toggle
Heading: "Start on the Floor or the Treadmill"
**Floor:** "Dumbbells, resistance bands, and bodyweight movements target specific muscle groups each day. Our instructors guide every rep to ensure proper form and maximum results."
**Treadmill:** "From power walks to all-out sprints, the treadmill portion is designed to torch calories and build cardiovascular endurance. Every speed and incline is coach-led — all levels welcome."

## Weekly Class Schedule

| Day | Muscle Group Focus |
|---|---|
| Monday | Chest & Back |
| Tuesday | Full Body (Lower Focus) |
| Wednesday | Arms & Abs |
| Thursday | Arms & Abs |
| Friday | Full Body (Upper Focus) |
| Saturday | Full Body |

## Studio Experience
Heading: "Meet Us in the Red Room."
Body: "Red lights. Loud music. Zero distractions. Our studios are purpose-built for performance — every detail from the sound system to the lighting is engineered to push you harder. This isn't a gym. This is the Red Room."
CTA: "THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD — Don't Wait. Book Now to Get the Red Room Experience."

## Free Trial CTA
Heading: "JOIN US FOR A FREE 30 DAY TRIAL"
CTA: "Start Your Free Trial"

Instructors are displayed as a filterable card grid. Each card shows: instructor name, home studio, and a "Book a Class" link.

**Filter by location:** All Locations · New York · Los Angeles · London · Miami · San Francisco

- **Dani Reyes** — New York
- **Marcus Cole** — Los Angeles
- **Priya Nair** — London
- **Jordan Voss** — Miami
- **Tessa Kim** — San Francisco
- **Andre Williams** — New York
- **Sofia Marquez** — Los Angeles
- **Liam Chen** — London

CTA: "Get Started Today" | "Book a Class"

|---|---|
| What is RIDE x LIFT? | RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio. |
| What should I wear? | Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required. |
| Do I need cycling shoes? | No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer. |
| How long is the class? | Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor. |
| Is RIDE x LIFT good for beginners? | Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level. |
| Where is RIDE x LIFT available? | RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations. |

# RedRoom Fitness — The Best HIIT Workout in the World

## Brand
RedRoom Fitness is the original high-intensity interval training experience, combining treadmill running and strength training in a signature red-lit studio environment. Founded for those who demand more from their workout, RedRoom delivers results through science-backed HIIT methodology across global studio locations and a digital on-demand platform. The tone is bold, dark, and unapologetically intense.

Brand colors: `#FF0000` (RedRoom Red — primary), `#141414` (Charcoal Black — background), `#FFFFFF` (White — text/accent)

## Hero Content
Title: "TRY THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD™"
Subtitle: "Buy an exclusive first-timer 3-pack and receive a FREE Fuel Shake or Grab + Go item after your third class."
CTA: "BUY NOW" | "BOOK CLASSES"

## Top Bar Promo
Text: "The Best (Digital) Workout in the World"

CTA: "Explore the Community"

## Two Ways to Red Room
Heading: "TWO WAYS TO RED ROOM"
Option 1: **In-Studio** — "Get a (Red) Room. Step inside our signature red-lit studios for the full immersive experience. Heart-pounding music, elite instructors, and the energy of the pack."
Option 2: **Digital** — "Go Digital. Stream world-class workouts from anywhere. Same intensity, your schedule."

## The Workout — Method Overview
Heading: "THE REDROOM WAY"
Body: "Every class is a 50-minute full-body experience. You'll alternate between the treadmill and the floor, combining high-intensity cardio intervals with focused strength training. Our method is designed to maximize calorie burn, build lean muscle, and keep your metabolism elevated for hours after class. Hustle and heart set us apart."

## Floor vs. Treadmill Toggle
Heading: "Start on the Floor or the Treadmill"
**Floor:** "Dumbbells, resistance bands, and bodyweight movements target specific muscle groups each day. Our instructors guide every rep to ensure proper form and maximum results."
**Treadmill:** "From power walks to all-out sprints, the treadmill portion is designed to torch calories and build cardiovascular endurance. Every speed and incline is coach-led — all levels welcome."

## Weekly Class Schedule

| Day | Muscle Group Focus |
|---|---|
| Monday | Chest & Back |
| Tuesday | Full Body (Lower Focus) |
| Wednesday | Arms & Abs |
| Thursday | Arms & Abs |
| Friday | Full Body (Upper Focus) |
| Saturday | Full Body |

## Studio Experience
Heading: "Meet Us in the Red Room."
Body: "Red lights. Loud music. Zero distractions. Our studios are purpose-built for performance — every detail from the sound system to the lighting is engineered to push you harder. This isn't a gym. This is the Red Room."
CTA: "THE BEST WORKOUT IN THE WORLD — Don't Wait. Book Now to Get the Red Room Experience."

CTA: "Get Started Today" | "Book a Class"

## RIDE FAQ Content

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| What is RIDE x LIFT? | RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio. |
| What should I wear? | Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required. |
| Do I need cycling shoes? | No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer. |
| How long is the class? | Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor. |
| Is RIDE x LIFT good for beginners? | Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level. |
| Where is RIDE x LIFT available? | RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations. |

50 minutes. Treadmill. Floor. Results. This is the workout that changes everything.

Every class is a 50-minute full-body experience. You'll alternate between the treadmill and the floor, combining high-intensity cardio intervals with focused strength training. Weekly Class Schedule

Monday Chest & Back
Tuesday Full Body (Lower Focus)

Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required.
No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer.

Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level.
RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations.

steps.message:
{"type": "text", "text": "# Simplify: Code Review and Cleanup

Review all changed files for reuse, quality, and efficiency. Fix any issues found.

## Phase 1: Identify Changes

Run `git diff` (or `git diff HEAD` if there are staged changes) to see what changed. If there are no git changes, review the most recently modified files that the user mentioned or that you edited earlier in this conversation.

## Phase 2: Launch Three Review Agents in Parallel

Use the Agent tool to launch all three agents concurrently in a single message. Pass each agent the full diff so it has the complete context.

### Agent 1: Code Reuse Review

For each change:

1. **Search for existing utilities and helpers** that could replace newly written code. Look for similar patterns elsewhere in the codebase — common locations are utility directories, shared modules, and files adjacent to the changed ones.
2. **Flag any new function that duplicates existing functionality.** Suggest the existing function to use instead.
3. **Flag any inline logic that could use an existing utility** — hand-rolled string manipulation, manual path handling, custom environment checks, ad-hoc type guards, and similar patterns are common candidates.

### Agent 2: Code Quality Review

Review the same changes for hacky patterns:

1. **Redundant state**: state that duplicates existing state, cached values that could be derived, observers/effects that could be direct calls
2. **Parameter sprawl**: adding new parameters to a function instead of generalizing or restructuring existing ones
3. **Copy-paste with slight variation**: near-duplicate code blocks that should be unified with a shared abstraction
4. **Leaky abstractions**: exposing internal details that should be encapsulated, or breaking existing abstraction boundaries
5. **Stringly-typed code**: using raw strings where constants, enums (string unions), or branded types already exist in the codebase
6. **Unnecessary JSX nesting**: wrapper Boxes/elements that add no layout value — check if inner component props (flexShrink, alignItems, etc.) already provide the needed behavior
7. **Unnecessary comments**: comments explaining WHAT the code does (well-named identifiers already do that), narrating the change, or referencing the task/caller — delete; keep only non-obvious WHY (hidden constraints, subtle invariants, workarounds)

### Agent 3: Efficiency Review

Review the same changes for efficiency:

1. **Unnecessary work**: redundant computations, repeated file reads, duplicate network/API calls, N+1 patterns
2. **Missed concurrency**: independent operations run sequentially when they could run in parallel
3. **Hot-path bloat**: new blocking work added to startup or per-request/per-render hot paths
4. **Recurring no-op updates**: state/store updates inside polling loops, intervals, or event handlers that fire unconditionally — add a change-detection guard so downstream consumers aren't notified when nothing changed. Also: if a wrapper function takes an updater/reducer callback, verify it honors same-reference returns (or whatever the "no change" signal is) — otherwise callers' early-return no-ops are silently defeated
5. **Unnecessary existence checks**: pre-checking file/resource existence before operating (TOCTOU anti-pattern) — operate directly and handle the error
6. **Memory**: unbounded data structures, missing cleanup, event listener leaks
7. **Overly broad operations**: reading entire files when only a portion is needed, loading all items when filtering for one

## Phase 3: Fix Issues

Wait for all three agents to complete. Aggregate their findings and fix each issue directly. If a finding is a false positive or not worth addressing, note it and move on — do not argue with the finding, just skip it.

When done, briefly summarize what was fixed (or confirm the code was already clean).


## Additional Focus

Review the RedRoom Fitness website in /app/output/ for code quality, reuse, and efficiency. Check CSS, JS, and all 5 HTML pages."}

**CSS (`/app/output/css/style.css`):**

1. **`@import` for Google Fonts (line 7)** -- Render-blocking. `@import` in CSS delays font discovery until the stylesheet is fully parsed. Replace with a `<link>` tag in the `<head>` (on all 5 pages) with `preconnect` hints to Google Fonts CDN.

2. **Duplicate `font-size` in `.feature-card__icon` (lines 1047 and 1055)** -- Declared as `2rem` then immediately overridden to `1.5rem` in the same rule block. Remove the dead `2rem` declaration.

3. **`.instructor-card[style*="display: none"]` (line 877)** -- Fragile attribute selector targeting inline styles, plus `!important`. The class `.instructor-card--hidden` (line 881) already exists but JS never uses it -- it writes inline styles instead.

**JS (`/app/output/js/main.js`):**

4. **No debouncing on scroll handler (line 269)** -- `initScrollAnimations()` calls `getBoundingClientRect()` on every scroll event with no throttle/debounce. Even with `{ passive: true }`, this triggers forced layout. Add `requestAnimationFrame` debouncing.

5. **Carousel autoplay overlap (lines 101-116)** -- `touchend` handler (line 114) calls `stopAutoplay()` (redundant -- `touchstart` already stopped it at line 113) then sets `setTimeout(startAutoplay, 3000)`. If `mouseleave` fires during that 3-second window, `startAutoplay()` runs twice, creating duplicate intervals. Track the interval and clear before re-setting.

7. **Instructor filter sets inline styles per card (lines 154-162)** -- Writing `display`, `opacity`, and `transform` inline on every card on every filter click triggers layout thrashing. Use the existing `.instructor-card--hidden` class instead.

**HTML (all 5 pages):**

8. **40+ lines of nav/header/footer duplicated identically across all pages** -- Not a runtime perf issue, but a maintenance burden. A build-time include/partial would help.

9. **Repeated inline styles that should be classes** -- The `.studio-section__body` paragraph with `font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.4rem;` inline style appears identically in `index.html` (line 110) and `the-workout.html` (line 151). The `newsletter__feedback` div has `style="width: 100%; order: 3;"` on all 5 pages."}

RIDE x LIFT FAQ

RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio.
Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required.

REDROOM RIDE

Our signature cycling class. 50 minutes of spin and strength. All your questions, answered.

RIDE x LIFT FAQ

RIDE x LIFT is RedRoom's signature cycling class that combines a high-energy spin session with strength training on the floor. It's 50 minutes of total-body work set to motivating playlists in our red-lit studio.
Wear moisture-wicking athletic clothing and supportive sneakers. Cycling shoes are available at the studio but not required.
No. We provide complimentary cycling shoes at every RIDE x LIFT studio. You're welcome to bring your own SPD-compatible shoes if you prefer.
Each RIDE x LIFT class is 50 minutes — approximately 25 minutes on the bike and 25 minutes of strength work on the floor.
Absolutely. Our instructors coach every level. You control your resistance and speed, so the workout scales to your fitness level.
RIDE x LIFT is currently available at our Chelsea, NYC studio with plans to expand to additional locations.

steps.message:
The RedRoom Fitness corporate website is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

## `/app/output/` — 5-Page Static Website

### Files Created (7 total)
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `index.html` | Home — hero, community promo, two-ways cards, studio experience, free trial CTA, lifestyle carousel (5 slides with autoplay), newsletter, footer |
| `the-workout.html` | Workout — method overview, weekly schedule table (6 days), floor/treadmill toggle, studio experience, booking CTA |
| `instructors.html` | Instructors — filterable grid (5 locations, 8 instructors), booking CTAs |
| `ride-faq.html` | RIDE FAQ — 6-item accordion (single-open behavior), cycling class info |
| `digital-platform.html` | RedRoom X — 5 feature cards, workout types grid, unlimited access section, free trial CTA |
| `css/style.css` | Shared stylesheet (~1100 lines) — dark theme, responsive, CSS variables, utility classes |
| `js/main.js` | Shared JavaScript — carousel, accordion, instructor filter, floor/treadmill toggle, newsletter validation, country selector, scroll animations |

### Key Design Decisions
- **Dark theme**: `#141414` background, `#FF0000` red accent, white text — as specified in the brief
- **Fonts**: Oswald (headings) + Inter (body) loaded via `<link>` with preconnect for performance
- **Responsive**: Mobile nav overlay, stacked layouts, responsive table with `data-label` attributes
- **Accessibility**: ARIA labels on carousel/accordion, `aria-expanded` state management, `prefers-reduced-motion` support
- **Zero build step**: All pages open directly in a browser with relative paths

### Interactions Implemented
- Home carousel (arrows, dots, swipe, 5s autoplay with pause on hover/touch)
- Floor/Treadmill content toggle
- Instructor location filter (class-based show/hide)
- FAQ accordion (single-open, animated max-height)
- Newsletter email validation (regex + inline feedback)
- Footer country selector dropdown
- Scroll-triggered fade-up animations (debounced via `requestAnimationFrame`)
